scope: Eight-fault-case research raw simulation outputs and related experiments only. Excludes EnergyPlus, annual data, images and Markdown. No simulation or training resumed.

groups.name: Final eight-case raw N/U/R trajectory sources
groups.count: 8 final new U + 8 reused R + 5 unique reused N = 21 sources, 24 logical references
groups.value: Actual delivery, loads, shortfall, device output, stock, fuel, thermal state and physical cost over actual intervals. Use final registration to retain the correct referenced N/R; do not collect every old attempt as a final result.

groups.name: Initial state, common preparation and fault case definitions
groups.count: 8 topic common-preparation paths; not 8 additional independent fault trajectories
groups.value: CASE, INITIAL_STATE, common SEGMENTS and COMMON_CHECKPOINT retain pre-fault state, frozen branch shares, pending commands and actual inventories.

groups.name: Single tower and single pump mechanism comparisons
groups.count: 6 complete new trajectories: TOWER U/U0/R and PUMP U/U0/R
groups.value: Equipment-level and execution-mode comparisons; preserve original source binding. Earlier than final U source-partition repair.

groups.name: Parameter/background raw attempts including repairs and failures
groups.count: 96 attempts: 90 completed and 6 failed/stopped; complete outputs are 86 original + 3 r1 + 1 r3
groups.value: All raw archives, CASE and archive_index records for command delay, cooling time constants, initial stock, duration and load backgrounds; no pair-eligibility or benefit filtering. These do not include final 2026-11-05 U source-partition code.

groups.name: Recovery dispatch and steam-aware recovery experiments
groups.count: 3 completed: T05_R1_attempt02, T06_R1_attempt01, T05_R2_attempt01; plus T05_R1_attempt01 failed at 93min
groups.value: Recovery continuity and current-steam-aware strategy behavior. T06 wrapper process exited 1 while native run completed; WRAPPER_COMPLETION receipt must accompany the raw data. Earlier source, separate from final R references.

groups.name: Pre-final-repair complete paired trajectories
groups.count: 8 U and 8 R before the source-partition correction; the 8 R are already reused in group A
groups.value: Compare original and corrected U source allocation with original source/input identity; avoid counting shared R data twice.

groups.name: Time-step and model-consistency raw experiments
groups.count: Latest C7 has 6 completed T06 outputs; full qualification and production unfinished
groups.value: Step-size error, native/wrapper equivalence and event-transition diagnostics; retain original attempted runs, ledger and failures. Not qualified final eight-case production.

groups.name: Failures, stopped prefixes and solver/execution evidence
groups.count: Overlaps prior groups; not additional samples
groups.value: Retain FAILURE, FAILURE_CONTEXT, solver/event/state prefixes and stop receipts without treating incomplete tails as zero service. These support numerical and model-boundary diagnosis.

raw_file_roles.SEGMENTS.jsonl: Actual physical intervals and their operational variables; not plotting interpolation.
raw_file_roles.SOLVER_LOG.jsonl: Original retained solver records; empty logs can be intentional in no-optimization U, with preparation solver logs stored under common.
raw_file_roles.CASE_INITIAL_STATE_RESOLVED_CASE: Parameters, original case semantics and state initialization.
raw_file_roles.SOURCE_BINDING_ARCHIVE_INDEX_RECEIPTS: Version, input, archive and outcome provenance.

notes: Counts overlap, so do not sum all groups into an independent sample size.
Final T05 is a single tower adapter, T06 a single primary-pump adapter, and T08 has its own final U/R run sources. Old family aliases do not define the final package.
Older extensions keep their own model revision and have not all been rerun under the final U partition repair.
Raw data means simulation output, not hospital measurements.
Only metadata and file presence reviewed here; no full-payload hash audit performed.
